pkgmetadata.longdescription: NetBox installed in upstream's source-checkout layout under /opt/netbox, with configuration in /etc/netbox and media, scripts, reports and collected static files in /var/lib/netbox. Releases are built from the PyPI sdist, which carries the pre-rendered documentation site. Plugins are separate packages (dev-python/netbox-*, dev-python/netboxlabs-*).

use.flag: Install an www-servers/apache reverse proxy vhost (70_netbox.conf, gated by -D NETBOX)
Support git data sources via dev-python/dulwich
Install an www-servers/nginx reverse proxy config in /etc/netbox
Amazon S3 data sources and storage via dev-python/boto3
